title: List promotions — golden path
steps: Log in as franchisee@gmail.com with promotion_management:read permission
expected: Table renders with columns: Code, Name, Type, Value, Valid From, Valid Until, Usage, Status, Actions. Active promotions show green 'Active' badge; inactive show grey 'Inactive' badge.

title: Loading state renders PageLoader
steps: Navigate to the promotions tab while the API call is in-flight (throttle network)
Observe component render before data arrives
expected: PageLoader spinner is visible; table is not rendered yet.

title: Error state renders StatusCallout with Retry
steps: Force API to fail (mock network error or server returns 500)
expected: StatusCallout with error variant and 'Couldn't load promotions' title is shown. Clicking Retry re-fires the query.

title: Empty state — no promotions
steps: Ensure the test org has zero promotions
expected: Table renders with a single spanning row containing 'No promotions found.'

title: No organization selected shows placeholder
steps: Log in as a user with no currentOrganizationId (organizationId = null)
expected: Component renders message 'Select an organization to view promotions.' No table, no loading spinner.

title: Client-side search filters by code
steps: Load promotions tab with at least two promotions (e.g. 'SAVE20', 'WELCOME10')
expected: Only promotions whose code contains 'SAVE' (case-insensitive) are shown. Count updates. No API call made.

title: Client-side search filters by name
steps: Type part of a promotion name in the search box
expected: Only promotions whose name contains the search string are shown.

title: Search yields no results
steps: Load promotions tab with at least one promotion
expected: Table shows 'No promotions match your search.' Count shows 0.

title: Create promotion — percentage type golden path
steps: Fill Code='SUMMER20', Name='Summer Sale', Type='percentage', Value='20', Valid From=any future datetime
expected: Dialog closes. Toast 'Promotion created successfully.' appears. New promotion appears in table with Value column showing '20.00%'. storedValue = 2000 (basis points).

title: Create promotion — fixed amount type
steps: Fill Code='FLAT10', Name='Flat RM10 Off', Type='fixed_amount', Value='10.00', Valid From=any datetime
expected: Dialog closes. Toast success. Value column shows 'RM 10.00'. storedValue stored as 1000 (cents).

title: Create promotion — code too short (< 3 chars)
steps: Enter Code='AB', Name='Test', Type='percentage', Value='10', Valid From=now
expected: Form does NOT submit. Toast error 'Promo code must be at least 3 characters.' Dialog remains open.
selectorHints: getByText(/promo code must be at least 3/i)

title: Create promotion — code with invalid characters
expected: Toast error 'Promo code may only contain letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.' Dialog stays open.

title: Create promotion — percentage value > 100
expected: Toast error 'Percentage discount cannot exceed 100%'. Dialog stays open.

title: Create promotion — value = 0
steps: Enter Value='0', fill other required fields
expected: Toast error 'Please enter a valid value.' Dialog stays open.

title: Create promotion — value is NaN (non-numeric)
steps: Programmatically set Value to 'abc' (type=number browser may block, test via JS)
expected: Toast error 'Please enter a valid value.' Dialog stays open.

title: Create promotion — Valid From missing
steps: Fill all fields except Valid From
expected: Toast error 'Valid From date is required.' Dialog stays open.

title: Create promotion — Valid Until before Valid From
steps: Set Valid From = '2026-12-01T10:00', Valid Until = '2026-11-01T10:00' (before from)
expected: Toast error 'Valid Until must be after Valid From.' Dialog stays open.

title: Create promotion — Valid Until equal to Valid From
expected: Client guard: `new Date(validUntil) <= new Date(validFrom)` is true when equal — toast error 'Valid Until must be after Valid From.' is shown.

title: Create promotion — code auto-uppercased
steps: Type lowercase code 'save20' in the Code field
expected: Input value shows 'SAVE20' immediately as each character is typed (onChange converts to uppercase). Submitted code is 'SAVE20'.

title: Create promotion — minimum order amount converts to cents
expected: Server receives minimumOrderAmount = 5000 (cents). If promotion list is inspectable, createPromotion was called with minimumOrderAmount: 5000.

title: Create promotion — unlimited usage (blank usage limit)
expected: Promotion created with usageLimit = undefined (null in DB). Table shows '∞' in Usage column for that row.

title: Create promotion — server returns error (e.g. permission denied)
steps: Log in as user with promotion_management:read only (no create permission)
Open Create Dialog, fill valid form, submit
expected: Dialog remains open. Error toast appears with the server error message (FORBIDDEN). No row added to table.

title: Create promotion — duplicate code server rejection
steps: Submit with code 'DUP01' and otherwise valid fields
expected: Error toast with raw DB unique constraint violation message. Dialog remains open. NOTE: message is not user-friendly — this is a gap.

title: Cancel create dialog — form resets
expected: Dialog closes. Form is reset to defaultCreateForm (empty/default values). Reopening dialog shows blank form.

title: Edit promotion — golden path
steps: Click Edit on a promotion row
Verify name, description, validFrom, validUntil are pre-populated
expected: Dialog closes. Toast 'Promotion updated successfully.' Table row shows updated name. Code and type fields are NOT editable (shown in read-only info block).

title: Edit promotion — extend validity window
steps: Click Edit on an expiring promotion
Change Valid Until to a future date
expected: Server receives updated validUntil. Table row shows updated Valid Until date.

title: Edit promotion — remove expiry (set Valid Until to blank)
steps: Click Edit on a promotion that has a Valid Until date
expected: Server receives validUntil = undefined. Promotion updated. Table shows 'No expiry' in Valid Until column.

title: Edit promotion — Valid Until before Valid From client rejection
expected: Toast error 'Valid Until must be after Valid From.' Dialog stays open.

title: Edit promotion — Valid From missing client rejection
expected: Toast error 'Valid From date is required.' Dialog stays open.

title: Edit promotion — name trimmed to empty sends undefined
steps: Open Edit dialog for a promotion
expected: Server receives name = undefined. updatePromotion service leaves name unchanged (no name in update patch). RISK: update silently does nothing to name field rather than rejecting.

title: Edit promotion — server error (permission denied)
steps: Downgrade user to have promotion_management:read only
Open Edit dialog, make changes, save
expected: Error toast with FORBIDDEN message. Dialog stays open.

title: Deactivate button only visible for active promotions
steps: Load promotions tab with at least one active and one inactive promotion
Inspect Action cell for each row
expected: Active rows show both Edit and Deactivate buttons. Inactive rows show only Edit button (no Deactivate button).

title: Deactivate — golden path with confirmation
steps: Click Deactivate on an active promotion row
Verify confirmation dialog shows promotion name
expected: Confirmation dialog shows '...deactivate <promotion name>?'. On confirm: dialog closes, toast 'Promotion deactivated.', row Status changes to 'Inactive', Deactivate button disappears.

title: Deactivate — cancel confirmation closes dialog, no mutation
steps: Click Deactivate on an active promotion row
Click Cancel in the confirmation dialog
expected: Dialog closes. Promotion remains active. No API call made.

title: Deactivate — error toast shown but dialog already closed (bug)
steps: Mock deactivatePromotion API to return error
expected: RISK/BUG: deactivateTarget is cleared before mutation resolves (setDeactivateTarget(null) called synchronously). If mutation errors, dialog is gone and user sees error toast but cannot retry from the confirmation dialog — must scroll back to the row.

title: Deactivate — server error (permission denied)
steps: Ensure user has only promotion_management:read or :update
expected: Error toast with FORBIDDEN message. Promotion remains active.

title: Route guard — user without service_management:read redirected
steps: Log in as user with no service_management:read permission
expected: User is redirected to /dashboard?unauthorized=true before the promotions component mounts.

title: Server RBAC — user with service_management:read but no promotion_management:read
steps: Configure user to have service_management:read but NOT promotion_management:read
expected: Component renders. List query fires. Server returns FORBIDDEN (403). Component shows StatusCallout error state (isError = true).

title: Percentage value boundary — exactly 100% allowed
expected: Form submits successfully. storedValue = 10000 basis points. Promotion created with value = 10000.

title: Percentage value boundary — 100.01% client rejected
expected: Toast error 'Percentage discount cannot exceed 100%'. Form not submitted.

title: Decimal percentage stored as basis points
expected: storedValue = Math.round(8.5 * 100) = 850. Table displays '8.50%' (850 / 100). No data corruption.

title: Free item / buy_x_get_y value display shows raw integer
expected: Table shows '1' (plain integer via toString). No unit label. This is the current behavior — may confuse users expecting a price.

title: Pagination truncation — more than 50 promotions not shown
expected: RISK: Only 50 rows are shown (default limit). No pagination controls, no count indicator showing total vs. displayed. 51st promotion silently missing from table.

title: CopyableCell copies promo code to clipboard
steps: Load promotions tab with at least one promotion
Click the Code cell (CopyableCell) for a promotion
expected: Promo code is copied to the system clipboard. Copy confirmation feedback shown (per CopyableCell implementation).

title: Switching type in create dialog clears value field
expected: Value field is cleared to empty string when type changes. Label updates to 'Discount Amount (RM)'.

title: Network error during create mutation shows toast
steps: Open Create Dialog, fill valid form
Simulate network offline or timeout before submitting
expected: Error toast appears with the error message. Dialog remains open. No row added to table.

title: Server accepts validUntil <= validFrom (bypass client guard via API)
steps: Send direct API call to promotions.create with validUntil <= validFrom (bypassing UI)
expected: RISK: Server has no cross-field date validation. Promotion is created in an already-expired or instantly-expiring state. validatePromoCode will immediately return 'Promotion has expired'.

title: Server accepts promo code of length 1-2 (below client minimum of 3)
steps: Send direct API call to promotions.create with code='AB' (2 chars)
expected: RISK: Server schema has z.string().min(1), so 'AB' is accepted. Client would reject it. A 2-char code can exist in the DB but cannot be created via the UI.

title: isActive toggle missing from edit UI — cannot reactivate
steps: Open the Edit dialog for the deactivated promotion
Look for a way to reactivate it from the UI
expected: RISK: No isActive toggle exists in the edit dialog. Once deactivated via the UI, there is no UI path to reactivate. (Server update procedure accepts isActive but UI does not send it.)

title: maximumDiscount cap not settable from UI
steps: Open Create Dialog for a 'percentage' promotion
Look for a maximumDiscount or 'cap' field
expected: RISK: No maximumDiscount field in the UI. A 20% promotion with no cap applied to a RM 10,000 order yields RM 2,000 discount — potentially unintended. Cap can only be set via direct API.
